title.zh: 会计师（订明文件与资料）规则 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Accountants (Prescribed Documents and Information) Rules 2024 and come into operation on 9 December 2024.

heading.en: Prescribed documents under section 12B(1) of Act
Excluded documents under section 12B(3) of Act
Prescribed information under section 12B(4)(c) of Act
Fees for copies, extracts and certification

text.en:
5.—(1) The fees specified in the Schedule are payable in the manner determined by the Registrar.
(2) The Registrar may for any reason waive, refund or remit, whether wholly or in part, any fee specified in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 5
Fees
1.
For supplying a copy of, or an extract from, any document mentioned in rule 2 (without attachments) which is filed with the Registrar
$11 per document
2.
For supplying a copy of, or an extract from, any document mentioned in rule 2 (including attachments) which is filed with the Registrar
$26 per document
3.
Certification of a copy of, or an extract from, any document mentioned in rule 2 as the copy which is filed with the Registrar
$1 per page or part of a page for electronic certification
